title: PinPolicy::validate not called at startup — misconfigured retention silently allows GC of pinned articles
description: policy.rs provides PinPolicy::validate() which checks for empty policy, bad group patterns, and useless rules. main.rs constructs gc_pre_pin_rules and calls PinPolicy::new() but never calls .validate(). An operator who writes a malformed group pattern (e.g. '123abc') in pinning.rules gets no startup error; the rule silently fails to match and articles that should be pinned are GC'd. PinPolicy::validate() must be called at startup and must be a fatal error.
